description: Treasure token (common token)
card_name: Black Mask, Of The False Face Society
rules: Extortion — Whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control for the first time each turn, that player may have you create a Treasure token. If they don't, create and attach to that creature a colorless Equipment artifact token named Black Mask with "At the beginning of each end step, put a -1/-1 counter on equipped creature." Treasures you control are Clues in addition to their other types.

description: Treasure token (common token) with phrasing for 'that many' tokens
rules: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create that many Treasure tokens.

description: Treasure token (common token) with phrasing for 'a number of' tokens
rules:
Flying
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. Create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the result.

description: Clue token and food token (common tokens)
rules: Playing "Ketchup" — Whenever an opponent draws their second card each turn, create a Food token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {t}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life.") Hot Sauce Packet — {t}, Sacrifice a Food: Target creature gets -3/-0 until end of turn. Investigate. (Create a colorless Clue artifact token with "{2}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.")

description: Simple creature token with P/T and a keyword ability
rules:
First Strike, Force 3
At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a colorless 2/2 Super-Battle Droid artifact creature token with flying. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
Other creatures you control have force 1.
Other force-sensitive creatures you control have haste and get +1/+1.

description: Simple creature token with P/T and enters tapped. Token discovery shouldn't include the word 'tapped'.
rules:
Whenever Plo Koon or another force-sensitive permanent enters the battlefield, create two tapped 2/2 white Clone creature tokens. Then, if you control ten or more Clones, sacrifice Plo Koon and draw a card.
Force-sensitive creatures you control with base power 2 or less get +1/+1.

rules:
The Bad Batch enters the battlefield tapped. When it does, it deals 2 damage to target creature.
When The Bad Batch dies, if it dealt combat damage to a player this turn, create that many tapped 2/2 white Clone creature tokens.

description: Simple creature token with P/T, but you create X of those tokens. Token discovery shouldn't include the X.
rules: For each non-Sith creature, you lose 1 life, draw a card, and create X 2/2 white Clone creature tokens, then each of those tokens fights that creature.

description: Simple creature token with P/T plus a Treasure token (common).
rules:
Trample
Whenever General Grievous attacks, create a 1/1 colorless Droid artifact creature token.
Whenever a creature token you control dies, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn:
• Gain control of target artifact with mana value 3 or less until General Grievous leaves the battlefield.
• Create a Treasure token.

rules:

description: Card that creates a token that's a copy of another creature, but doesn't actually create any tokens with its own unique text. Token discovery should not create a token here.
rules:
Force 3
Pay 2 life, Sacrifice a creature: Surveil 2.
Whenever a creature you control dies, proliferate. Then, if X is the number of Midichlorian counters that were on that creature, create a token that's a copy of target creature on the battlefield or creature card in a graveyard with mana value less than or equal to X, except the token isn't legendary.

description: Card that just mentions tokens ('copies becomes tokens') but creates no tokens of its own. Token discovery should not create a token here.
rules: Replicate {3}{G} (When you cast this spell, copy it for each time you paid its replicate cost. Copies of permanent spells become tokens.) Channel — {G}{G}, Discard Zakru: Until end of turn, primal creatures you control have base power and toughness 8/10 as long as they aren’t attacking. (A permanent is primal if it has no activated or triggered abilities except mana abilities.)
